title: MSFS Marketplace Update: Lufthansa 100 Years & Ryanair 737 Career
description:
This week’s Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 Marketplace Update for April 30, 2026 is packed with must-have new releases for PC simmers, featuring highly anticipated international activities like the Lufthansa 100 Years B747 and Ryanair 737 Max Career alongside immersive new landing challenges you’ll want in your hangar.

🗺️ New activities added this week (PC)
The following activities (missions & challenges) were newly released in the marketplace this week:

🗺️ Perfect Flight: 100 Years of Lufthansa – B747 Edition (12 IFR missions & Centennial Livery)
🗺️ Perfect Flight: Pan Am Era Panama – A310 Edition (8 historical missions & iconic livery)
🗺️ Perfect Flight: Sabena Memorial – A320 & A330 Editions (Legacy airline mission packs)
🗺️ Perfect Flight: 737 Max Captain – Ryanair (8 career-style IFR missions with full dialogue)
🗺️ Perfect Flight: JetBlue on Veterans – A320 Edition (US-based mission service)
🗺️ Perfect Flight: Advanced Challenges – Spain Landings (16 precision landing challenges)
🗺️ Perfect Flight: Caribbean / Brazil & Guiana Landings (New regional skill challenges)
🗺️ Perfect Flight: Moonlit Wings (Night-themed immersive mission pack)

🕒 Chapters
00:00 - Intro
00:33 - The Legends & Memorials
04:17 - Commercial Career
06:29 - The Skill Arena

If you enjoyed this update, make sure to like, subscribe, and drop a comment below — which of these Perfect Flight missions are you picking up this week?
Thanks for watching and happy flying!

✈️ See you in the skies!
